user_query: Assess the provided sequence and identify its likely protein family/function. Report sequence length and basic properties, closest Swiss-Prot homologs with organism and identity/coverage, curated versus inferred functional annotations, catalytic activity/cofactors/pathway, and localization. Explicitly qualify uncertainty and avoid unsupported specificity.

warnings: Sequence-derived estimates assume an unmodified protein and do not account for processing, PTMs, bound ligands, or oligomers.

function: Involved in the biosynthesis of isopentenyl diphosphate (IPP) and dimethylallyl diphosphate (DMAPP), two major building blocks of isoprenoid compounds. Catalyzes the conversion of 4-diphosphocytidyl-2-C-methyl-D-erythritol 2-phosphate (CDP-ME2P) to 2-C-methyl-D-erythritol 2,4-cyclodiphosphate (ME-CPP) with a corresponding release of cytidine 5-monophosphate (CMP).

    </ns0:comment>
